summary: Iteration 360 — SB Access editable assist types: backend CRUD (public+admin) and dynamic client panel verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 10/10 passed. Admin UI CRUD (add/edit/toggle/delete) works through /admin/assist-types and sidebar link is wired under SERVICES > Taxi/Transport > 'Types d'assistance (SB Access)'. The client booking panel at /course?mode=assist renders the dynamic list from the public API (verified by creating two TEST_ types via admin REST while logged in as a real user — both appeared as panel-assist-{key} buttons alongside the 6 seeds, and disappeared after toggle/delete).
critical_code_review_comments: useAssistTypes.js silently swallows fetch errors and falls back to the hardcoded list; if the backend ever returns an empty active set, FALLBACK still shows (acceptable but a subtle UX trap — toggling all types off won't empty the client list because the hook keeps the fallback). Consider distinguishing 'empty by config' vs 'error'.
AdminAssistTypes uses window.confirm for delete — fine functionally but inconsistent with other admin pages that use modal confirms; minor UX polish.

Backend admin_create accepts arbitrary 'key' from the body without uniqueness check — two types with the same key can coexist. Recommend adding a unique index on `assist_types.key` or a 409 on duplicate to avoid panel collisions (two buttons sharing data-testid).
admin_update does not normalise/slug the provided 'key' (allows whitespace/upper-case/raw input) — same uniqueness concern.

(or any user role) and open /course?mode=assist — buttons rendered are data-testid=panel-assist-{key} sourced from GET /api/assist-types.
